{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|arg= local

|eff= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Sets the angular velocity of the object in world space as a 3D vector. The units are in Rad/s and rotations are clockwise.
{{Feature|important|Angular velocity is limited to a range of +-1000 Rad/s.}}

|s1= obj [[setAngularVelocity]] vector

|p1= obj: [[Object]] 

|p2= vector: [[Vector3D]] - angular velocity of the object in world space.

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>myHeli setAngularVelocity [0,0,1]; // will cause the helicopter to spin around a vertical line passing through its center</sqf>

|seealso= [[setVelocity]] [[setAngularVelocityModelSpace]] [[angularVelocity]]
}}
